# Locales

Complete sets of wording in other languages. Each one is typed as `Labels`, so the compiler reports a label that is missing. Pass one as `labels`; [docs/wording-and-locale.md](../../docs/wording-and-locale.md) explains how, and how to add a language.

## `he.ts`

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `he` | Hebrew wording for every label. Pass it as `labels`, with `dir="rtl"`: `<Checkout labels={he} dir="rtl" locale="he-IL" currency="ILS" … />`. It addresses the shopper in the plural ("הזינו"), which reads as neutral in Hebrew. |
